name: precurso-utn-agents
description: Pre-curso UTN — RAG y Arquitectura de Agentes. Monorepo npm workspaces.

scripts.prebuild:server: npm run build --workspace @precurso/contracts && npm run build --workspace @precurso/server
scripts.start: npm run prebuild:server && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @precurso/contracts && npm run build --workspace @precurso/server && npm run build --workspace @precurso/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @precurso/server && npm run lint --workspace @precurso/web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace @precurso/server && npm run lint:fix --workspace @precurso/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @precurso/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @precurso/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
